02 / TAGS & PUBLICATIONS

Two expressions.
One brand identity.

Tags accompany individual products. Catalogues and publications give a longer story room to unfold. Each needs its own brief.

A / PRODUCT TAGS

Information at the right touchpoint.

Identity, sizing, instructions or product information. Consider both sides, holes or slots and the way a tag attaches for display.

B / CATALOGUES & PUBLICATIONS

More room to tell the story.

Start with the reader, format, content and page count. Discuss cover/interior paper, layout and binding for your publication.

03 / PAPER, LAYOUT & FINISHING

Considered on paper.
Clear in content.

From a single tag face to multiple printed pages, consider materials and content structure together.

01

Paper & surface feel

Describe the desired structure, feel and colours. For publications, discuss cover and interior paper around its use.

02

Content & imagery

Prepare approved content, logos and genuine product photographs. Agree on reading order, spacing and text size.

03

Holes, slots & binding

Tags need to fit the attachment point. Catalogues need a page count including covers and a binding approach. Confirm details with a sample.

05 / BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few things
worth knowing.

A little preparation makes the first conversation more useful.

Ask us on Zalo
01How do briefs for tags and catalogues differ?＋

For tags, share size, content on both sides, hole or slot position and attachment method. For catalogues, share finished size, content, page count including covers and preferred binding.

02When should catalogue size and page count be agreed?＋

Start with available content and photographs, the intended format and how readers will use it. Page count, layout and binding are discussed together before approval; content changes may require adjustments.

03What if artwork or product photographs are incomplete?＋

Share your logo, available content and visual direction. HotPrint will discuss missing material and design scope. Product images, specifications and descriptions need your confirmation before approval.

04How are custom tag holes, slots and shapes planned?＋

Share references and how the tag attaches to the product. Hole or slot placement, dimensions, materials and fit need sample checks before order specifications are confirmed.

05Can I review paper, colour and layout samples?＋

Request reference samples or samples based on your artwork. Agree on what the sample shows: paper, colour, both sides, pages or binding. Conditions, costs and timing are discussed individually.

06What information is needed for a quotation?＋

Share the tag or publication type, size, quantity, sides or pages, paper/finishing requirements and any artwork. HotPrint quotes after reviewing the brief; there is no single price or timeline for all orders.
